summary_1line: Krishna explains his divine incarnations, the nature of action and inaction, and the supremacy of knowledge and selfless sacrifice for liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna, radiant on the battlefield chariot, tells Arjuna that he manifests age after age whenever righteousness declines.
A blazing sacred fire consumes offerings as sages symbolize knowledge burning all actions to ashes.
Arjuna bows before Krishna in inquiry while the vast battlefield stretches behind them.
